analogs.covers: Almost everything: a pack of up to 8, endurance chases, tag-team bites, nomads that follow the herds

headline: An African wild dog pack: eight nomads that run prey to exhaustion with tag-team bites.

setting.label: Long-distance nomad of canyons, hills and forests, following the herds
setting.note: Diurnal. Travels long distances behind herds to learn migration patterns and find new hunting opportunities.

playsLike: You travel in a mixed-sex pack of up to 8, with at most 2 females, and cover huge distances behind migrating herds. Hunts are endurance events: you run prey down, dart in for a bite, dart out, and rotate attackers until it tires. Five hunters can take Apex herbivores, but you must pick Medium-or-smaller prey and offspring first, and you avoid Apex carnivores.

why.text: Up to 8 sub/adults with a hunting party of 5, the size and teamwork of a wild-dog pack (official inspiration).
Runs prey down to exhaustion, nipping and alternating attackers and jumping clear after each bite. That is exactly how wild dogs chase.
Sprint 1,150 held for 133 s at a light 2,400 combat weight, one of the faster medium carnivores. It is built for running, not wrestling.
Defenders rush to free a clamped packmate even from an Apex, and females fight to the end for their female companion. Wild dogs are famous for this loyalty.
Nomadic, following herds and learning migration routes. Wild dogs range across enormous home ranges.

notLike: Wild dog packs centre on one breeding pair; Alioramus packs revolve around a bonded female pair with up to six males in a fluid dominance hierarchy.
twist: Social flavour from mandrills (official inspiration): males jostle for rank and bully at kills, while the females keep the peace.
